status: applied (N1 agent, 19 Nov 2026): taxonomy.CAR_MAP_PARTS (+ twins), the firm wording, vehicleZones.ts zones and stand-ins; offered and suggested only while intake_car_map_names is on
fields: name ({side} = Left and Right), sided, twin (its side-undetermined name), area, assembly (the car map assembly it belongs to), role, hidden, strip_down, fitted, body, firm (Annex A floor wording, side code added last), firm_hatch (tailgate wording), zone (3D zone key: one, or per Left / Right / twin), stand_in (where it really is, for the 3D map), coarse (today's name that also covers it), also_check (the words shown when the names are off), why

names.name: Front Bumper Absorber
names.why: The foam or plastic energy absorber between cover and beam; priced on its own once the bumper is off.

names.name: {side} Front Bumper Bracket
names.why: The slide or retainer the cover's end clips into below the headlamp; a pushed or torn bumper end snaps it.

names.name: Front Parking Sensor
names.why: Today's Parking Sensor has no end, so a front bumper can't link it; the split lets the front one be named.

names.name: {side} Fog Lamp Cover
names.why: The bezel or blank cover in the bumper's lower corners; it breaks with the cover even on cars with no fog lamp.

names.name: Radiator Support
names.why: The panel that carries the radiator, latch and headlamp inner mounts; a frontal push past the beam bends it.

names.name: Radiator Fan
names.why: Sits behind the radiator; a radiator pushed back cracks the shroud or blades.

names.name: {side} Bonnet Hinge
names.why: A bonnet pushed back or folded bends its hinges; uneven bonnet-to-fender gaps at the rear corners are the sign.

names.name: Bonnet Latch
names.why: Bolted to the radiator support under the bonnet's front edge; a bonnet that will not shut or open points at it.

names.name: Bonnet Insulator
names.why: The pad clipped under the bonnet; renewed when the bonnet is buckled or replaced.

names.name: {side} Front Door Lock
names.why: A door pushed in at its rear edge, or one that will not open or latch, usually has a bent lock.

names.name: {side} Rear Door Lock
names.why: As the front door's: a jammed rear door or one pushed in at its rear edge.

names.name: {side} Front Door Hinge
names.why: A hit at the door's front edge or a sagging door bends the hinges; a door that drops when opened is the sign.

names.name: {side} Rear Door Hinge
names.why: As the front door's, on the centre pillar.

names.name: {side} Front Door Handle
names.why: The outer handle sits in the skin; a dent or scrape across it often cracks or scratches it.

names.name: {side} Rear Door Handle
names.why: As the front door's.

names.name: Rear Bumper Absorber
names.why: The energy absorber between the rear cover and beam.

names.name: {side} Rear Bumper Bracket
names.why: The retainer the rear cover's end clips into under the tail lamp; a pushed or torn bumper end snaps it.

names.name: Rear Parking Sensor
names.why: The rear half of today's Parking Sensor, so the front and rear ones can be told apart.

names.name: Boot Lid Striker
names.why: The loop the lid's lock catches, on the panel under the opening; a panel pushed forward bends it.

names.name: {side} Boot Lid Strut
names.why: The gas struts that hold a tailgate or lid up; a lid pushed out of line bends them. Some lids use torsion bars.

names.name: Rear Number Plate Lamp
names.why: Sits in the lid's garnish or the bumper above the plate; a hit at the plate cracks it.

names.name: Boot Lid Garnish
names.why: The trim strip across the lid that holds the plate lamps and often the camera.

names.name: Boot Lid Spoiler
names.why: The spoiler on the lid's top or rear edge; on many hatches it also holds the high-mount stop lamp.

names.name: Rear Wiper Motor
names.why: Inside a tailgate under the rear glass; a tailgate pushed in at its centre can crack it. Hatches and estates only.

names.name: High Mount Stop Lamp
names.stand_in: at the top of the boot lid or rear glass
names.why: On a tailgate's top edge or spoiler; a tailgate twisted or pushed in can crack it.

names.name: Fuel Filler Flap
names.why: The flap in one rear quarter; a dent across it bends the flap or its hinge. Which side is the car's own fact.
